---
title: "Exercise 3.4"
---

## Solution
\begin{align*}
\mu(A)+\mu(B) &= \mu\big( (A \cap B) \cup (A \setminus B) \big) +\mu(B) \\[6pt]
&= \mu(A \cap B) + \mu(A\setminus B)+\mu(B) \\[6pt]
&= \mu(A \cap B) + \mu\big((A\setminus B) \cup B \big) \\[6pt]
&= \mu(A \cap B) + \mu(A \cup B).
\end{align*}
